name: Trim Paint Cleanup — Template
intent: Final inspect + touchup on the trim substrate, plus floor protect teardown + wall mask removal at the room level. Teardown tasks gate off when a pass_group_id is set so a finish-group shared cleanup can own them. Extended by per-substrate MOD_CLEANUP_<substrate>_PAINT modules.
doctrine: Default height:true matches the majority of trim substrates. Floor-adjacent (baseboard, shoe mold, chair rail) and door frame/casing override height:false. Mirrors the height-default choice in MOD_TEMPLATE_TRIM_PAINT/PRIME_INITIAL/INTERSTAGE.
